title: How scores work

How scores work
Every number in Body compares you with yourself. Badges show how far to trust each one; they change as life checks each score against reference devices.
ReadinessPersonal baseline
HRV vs your 60-day baseline (40%), resting heart rate (25%), sleep performance (25%), breathing rate (10%). Shown after 14 days.Based on: HRV time-domain standards (Task Force, 1996)
HRVPersonal baseline
RMSSD from beat-to-beat data, or SDNN where only that is available; never mixed.Based on: Task Force, 1996
LoadEstimate
Heart-rate-zone minutes weighted by zone, scaled 0–21.Based on: Karvonen heart-rate reserve; Edwards TRIMP
Sleep needEstimate
Your learned baseline + a third of recent debt + a load adjustment.Based on: Population range 7–9 h (NHS)
Body signalsPersonal baseline
Each signal's distance from your own normal range.Based on: Personal baseline z-scores
StressEstimate
Heart rate above resting with lower HRV while still.Based on: Estimate; checked against how you say you felt
Not a medical device. Not affiliated with any wearable brand.
